blocks.text: SM Supermalls has three malls on WorldWorthy’s 100 Best Shopping Malls 2026 list, more than any other mall operator in the Philippines. SM Mall of Asia leads the country’s entries at No. 29 worldwide and is ranked No. 1 in the Philippines, followed by SM Megamall at No. 41 and SM Seaside City Cebu at No. 94. SM Mall of Asia earned a WorldWorthy score of 8.98, making the bayside mall in Pasay City the fifth-highest-ranked mall in Asia and placing it ahead of the United Kingdom’s Trafford Centre (No. 31), Pavilion Kuala Lumpur (No. 40) and Seoul’s Lotte World Mall […]...
